messages:
maria: heads-up — observed a p99 latency spike on SM90 prod pool during the 11:30 load test. traces point at repeated paged-fusion -> fallback transitions. :eyes:
ashwin: ugh. can you paste the perf snippet / topo? sequence length and batch?
liam: saw this on canary too. quick numbers from the 11:30 run:
```
model: redwood-optim-3b
seq_len: 4096
batch: 2 (concurrent requests)
kernel path chosen: flash_paged_fusion -> fallback_cuda_attn
p50: 110ms
p95: 420ms
p99: 1.2s (spikey)
tokens/s (avg): 4200
```
maria: thanks. nvprof shows lots of kernel relaunches and a KV-cache miss storm when the fused paged kernel fails, then we hit the slow per-layer CUDA fallback. attaching short trace below.
```
[TRACE] layer 4: paged_fusion init ok
[TRACE] layer 4: kernel launch failed (cudaErrorLaunchFailure) -> fallback
[TRACE] kv-cache hits drop from 98% -> 63% across timeline
[TRACE] repeated recompile attempts (selector) ~3 times per request
```
deploy-bot: deploy 197a3c1 to prod-sm90 at 11:28 (auto-rollback enabled) :white_check_mark:
sophie: two hypotheses: (1) selector logic mis-evaluates SM90 perf hints and prefers paged_fusion for patterns it's not tuned for, (2) CUDA runtime changes (12.x) on SM90 cause nondet kernel failures — we saw similar with older Triton kernels.
nashwin: how does this compare to SM80? liam, do you have cross-arch numbers?
liam: quick diff from the same test on SM80 nodes: p99 ~ 480ms, no fallback churn. tokens/s ~ 4600. L2 miss rate ~3% vs 12% on SM90 when fallback happens. so SM90 is faster normally but the cost of fallback is huge.
sophie: interesting — could be a selector threshold issue where latency SLOs are prioritized incorrectly vs stability. might need a confidence check before switching kernels mid-request.
maria: repro steps for anyone who wants to run locally:
```
./bench/run_attn.sh --model redwood-optim-3b --seq 4096 --concurrency 2 --arch sm90 --kernel-selector=auto --triton=false
# observe logs: selector -> paged_fusion -> cuda_fallback
```
nashwin: will run now. adding a quick probe: set env SELECTOR_MAX_SWITCHES=0 to force single-choice, see if p99 stabilizes.
liam: also try running with the Triton bundle (--triton=true) on SM90. earlier we had a Triton patched kernel that avoided relaunch but may be incompatible with 12.3.
devops-bot: note: 2 SM90 nodes at ip-10-2-7-14 show elevated GPU ECC correctable errors during window (optional correlation).
maria: action items:
- ashwin + liam: reproduce on canary with SELECTOR_MAX_SWITCHES=0 and with triton=true (ashwin) — collect nvprof and selector logs
- sophie: add a pre-switch confidence metric to selector (simple: require successful init >=2 consecutive inits before switching) — try on canary
- ops: check CUDA driver version drift between pools (pin to 12.2 if needed)
I can own coordinating a hotfix if we can reproduce.
ashwin: stepping through now, will post logs in this thread. :thumbsup:
